metadata.description: Wire format for `vibe-index search <data-dir> <query> --json`: full-text search over the index, scored, capped by `--limit`, optionally filtered by kind. Read by scripts and agents (PROP-044 §6.5 — a CLI `--json` report is a format plain text; `foreign_parsers = many`). Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/cli/search.rs` (`Envelope`, `HitRow`); the generated reader this schema owns lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_cli/e1/search_report/`.
The query as the ask spelled it, echoed back verbatim.
How many hits `hits` carries — the count AFTER the `--limit` cap. Bounded by construction and checked at the wire boundary.
The capped hit list, sorted by descending score then `(group, name)`. Required member: a matchless query writes `[]`, never an absent key — the writer has no skip here.
One search hit — the package's newest scored version with the tokens that matched and the refusals named beside the package.
The kind of the scored version — metadata per PROP-008 §2.3; the kind filter, when the ask carried one, compared against exactly this.

The version the hit scored (the newest version this build can act on — stable when one exists, otherwise the newest of any kind), `null` cannot occur from the search walk today (a hit exists exactly because a scored version does) but the writer's `Option` carries no skip, so the key is always present on the wire.
The hit's relevance score (distinct query-token overlap over the scored version's name, description and keywords). Bounded by construction and checked at the wire boundary.

The query tokens that matched the scored version, in set order. Required member: a hit exists exactly because this is non-empty, and the writer has no skip here — the empty list stays a lawful wire shape for the reader.
The scored version's description, `null` when it declares none. The key is always present: the writer's `Option` carries no skip.

Versions of the hit's package this build refuses to act on — named, not hidden (PROP-044 §4.5); they ride the hit's package, not the scored version. Absent when there are none (the writer carries `skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty"`).

One version this build refused to act on, and why — the row every `vibe-index` answering surface carries (`crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs`, `Unavailable`). Local to this schema family: `formats/vocabularies.json` does not (yet) carry it, and each of the six report schemas that need it declare their own copy.
The refused version's bare package name.

The reader capabilities of `must_understand` this build lacks, in the record's own order. Required member: a refusal always writes its list, `[]` never occurring in practice today (a row exists exactly because the list is non-empty) but lawful on the wire — the writer has no skip here.
What a person or a script does about it — the fixed two-part text `recipe_for` builds (the explanation with the PROP-044 anchor, then the `fix:` surface).
